row.title: A merge by the built-in token fires no push workflow
row.body: Bot merges (GitHub auto-merge enabled by github-actions, or the lane) left every on-push workflow silent after #2243: seed-launch and three deploys never ran. scripts/postmerge_dispatch.py reads each workflow's own push paths and the lane dispatches what a merge touched; tests pass in tests/foundation/test_postmerge_dispatch.py; residual risk: a PR merged more than 6 h before the lane's next pass is not caught.

title: A merge by the built-in token fires no push workflow
